title: Recording: Brandy by Ringo Starr | 1980
content:
Cherokee Studios, Los Angeles
Producers: Ringo Starr, Ronnie Wood
Engineer: Dee Robb

Ringo Starr began recording the Stop And Smell The Roses outtake ‘Brandy’ on 25 September 1980.

The song was co-written and co-produced by Starr and The Rolling Stones’ Ronnie Wood.

On this day Wood recorded guitar, piano, and bass guitar. More overdubs followed on 27 September before the song was abandoned.
